prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1125; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the best number to reach you.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but you have my details on file.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened when you entered the intersection?

A: I was driving through on a green light, heading straight across. A pickup coming from my right side didn't stop for its red and clipped the driver's side of my car. It hit me just behind the front door.

Q: Did you see the pickup before the impact?

A: Only for a second. I glanced over and saw it moving fast, but I didn't have time to react.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: How fast were you going, approximately?

A: Maybe 30 miles an hour, the posted limit there.

Q: Did you get out of the car or speak with the other driver?

A: I got out. The other driver said he was sorry and that he got distracted. We exchanged insurance information and a police officer came out.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lower back strain. I've had some stiffness and soreness since then, and I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms today?

A: Yes, the neck is better than it was, but my lower back still bothers me when I sit for long periods.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add that I haven't asked about?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
